name: Solanki Dynasty Architecture Trail
description: Journey through the golden age of Solanki architecture, visiting the Sun Temple at Modhera, the UNESCO Queen's Stepwell at Patan, and Adalaj Stepwell.

name: 5,000-Year Harappan Trade Trail
description: Trace the footsteps of Bronze Age traders from the ancient stone reservoirs of Dholavira in Kutch to the world's oldest engineered dockyard at Lothal.

name: Saurashtra Coast & Royal Citadel Trail
description: Explore the ancient Mauryan citadel of Uparkot in Junagadh, the seashore Somnath Jyotirlinga, and the sacred 5-storey spire at Dwarka.
